# Allen P. Green, MD

Allen P. Green, MD is a Board-Certified Clinical Pathologist and Associate Medical Director
at Global Apheresis in Mill Valley, California, specializing in therapeutic plasma exchange (TPE).

## About
- Board-Certified in Clinical Pathology
- Trained at UT Southwestern Medical Center under Dr. Ravi Sarode
- Over 500 TPE procedures performed
- Multiple peer-reviewed publications in apheresis and transfusion medicine
- Associate Medical Director, Global Apheresis (2026-present)
- Previously: TPE protocol development at a leading longevity clinic in Dallas (2025)

## Therapeutic Plasma Exchange (TPE)
TPE removes and replaces a patient's plasma, clearing inflammatory proteins, pro-aging molecules,
autoantibodies, and environmental toxins. Global Apheresis uses the Spectra Optia apheresis system.
Dr. Green performs TPE for four primary applications:
- Alzheimer's disease and cognitive decline (ASFA Category III; AMBAR trial evidence)
- Longevity and biological age reduction
- Autoimmune conditions (lupus, myasthenia gravis, ANCA vasculitis, and others)
- Environmental detoxification (PFAS, heavy metals, persistent organic pollutants)

## AMBAR Trial
The AMBAR trial (Alzheimer's Management By Albumin Replacement) studied 322 treated patients.
Results at 14 months: 52% less decline on ADCS-ADL, 66% on ADAS-Cog, 71% on CDR-Sum of Boxes.
TPE for Alzheimer's is ASFA Category III.
